subregion.name: The Blackwood Nave
subregion.summary: A soaring, shadowy junction of arched chambers and intersecting central walkways.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, center
subregion.summary: The tangled heart of the woods where several major tracks converge.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, east
subregion.summary: Twisting trails and shadowed glades spanning the eastern forest.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, far southeast
subregion.summary: The low-lying woods and muddy passages bordering the marsh.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, north
subregion.summary: Overgrown trails winding beneath the northern forest canopy.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, south-central
subregion.summary: A central southern corridor choked by briars and damp underbrush.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, southeast interior
subregion.summary: Sunken groves and winding paths along the inner southeastern woods.

subregion.name: Gloomwald, west
subregion.summary: Misty hollows and winding paths across the western forest.

subregion.name: The Hollow Undercroft
subregion.summary: A cold labyrinth of damp flagstone vaults and abandoned cellars in the far northwest.

subregion.name: The Lichen Barrow
subregion.summary: Cramped stone tombs and burial chambers carpeted in pale moss in the northeast.

subregion.name: The Mist-Veil Cross
subregion.summary: Fog-filled intersections connecting the central halls to the lower southern descents.

subregion.name: The Moss-Deep Tunnels
subregion.summary: Winding passages carved through dark rock where subterranean water constantly drips.

subregion.name: The Shattered Colonnade
subregion.summary: Grand collapsed pillared halls choked with creeping briars along the northern ridge.

subregion.name: The Sunken Sepulchre
subregion.summary: Low-ceilinged eastern catacombs half-flooded by stagnant subterranean seepage.

subregion.name: The Tangle-Root Gate
subregion.summary: The southeastern threshold where ancient roots burst through broken stonework.

subregion.name: The Forgotten Cistern
subregion.summary: Cavernous southwestern reservoirs and stone aqueducts echoing with distant trickles.

subregion.name: The Gloom Spine
subregion.summary: A long, straight descent of interconnected pillared passages running south.

subregion.name: The Thorn-Tangled Galleries
subregion.summary: Overgrown eastern corridors and courtyards tangled in thick, thorny brambles.

subregion.name: The Whispering Catacombs
subregion.summary: Narrow winding passageways and hidden crypts along the western decline.
